# tests/fixtures

Deterministic test data: `cargo-sandbox/` (a tiny crate the executor sandbox
builds in `macos_cargo.rs`), `structured_memory/` (gate and recall cases read
by `structured_memory.rs`, plus the `phase7/` corpus for
`structured_memory_phase7.rs` and `examples/structured_memory_eval.rs`),
`web-research/` (an offline page corpus for
`examples/web_research_benchmark.rs`). No fixture contacts the network.
